label: Line race
reads: who was ahead, and when it changed

label: Slope
reads: before and after, for several teams

label: Results strip
reads: a run of results, game by game

label: Scatter
reads: two measures, every team or player

label: Small multiples
reads: the same chart for each team, side by side

label: Pitch map
reads: where on the pitch (shots, passes, pressing)

label: Bracket
reads: a knockout, tie by tie, round by round to the final

label: Table
reads: the standings, or exact values to look up

label: Heat table
reads: a grid of values, coloured by size

label: Photo-style
reads: a picture or illustration, little text
